design.quote: The results of BEST-D were combined in a meta-analysis of all trials of vitamin D v. placebo on levels of P1NP (12 trials, 2654 participants) or CTX (16 trials, 2695 participants).

intervention.value: vitamin D3 (2000 IU/d or 4000 IU/d) / vitamin D supplements
intervention.quote: after treatment with 2000 IU/d or 4000 IU/d vitamin D3 or placebo

comparator.quote: 2000 IU/d or 4000 IU/d vitamin D3 or placebo

follow_up.quote: Geometric mean (se) levels at 12 months were similar for P1NP

primary_findings.quote: the average difference between the within-trial change in P1NP for allocated vitamin D and control was -3·3 % (95 % CI -5·6, -1·0, P < 0·005)
For CTX, this difference was slightly greater (-3·8 % (-6·8, -0·8); P = 0·01)
